title: Independent counters using closures
summary: Use a counter factory to process calls to independent named counters.
requirements: Input is an array of counter names (strings).
Create a separate counter, starting at 0, for each distinct name when first seen.
For each name, invoke its counter and append the incremented value to the result.
Implement an inner function that closes over its own count; do not use a single shared counter.
hints: Each call to a factory function can create its own lexical environment.
Store the returned counter functions in a Map keyed by name.
Invoke the correct stored function once for each input item.
